question: Who is known as the father of Green Revolution in the World?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Norman Borlaug.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Norman Borlaug** is known as the **father of Green Revolution** in the World.
 
• He was an** American agronomist** and **humanitarian **who is credited with saving over a billion people from starvation.
 
• Borlaug developed **high-yielding disease-resistant wheat varieties** that helped increase food production in developing countries.
 
• He received the **Nobel Peace Prize in 1970** for his contributions to world peace through increasing food supply.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **R. K. V. Rao** was an **Indian economist and statistician** who made significant contributions to the field of economics.

 
 
• The VKRV Rao Prizes in **Social Science Research **are given in his honor.
 
 
 
• **M. S. Swaminathan** is an Indian** geneticist and agronomist** who is known for his role in India's Green Revolution.
 
 
• He is referred to as "**the Father of Economic Ecology"** by the United Nations Environment Programme.
